<script>

var map = new GMap2();
var startpoint = new GLatLng(55.73, 38.87);
map.setCenter(startpoint, 9);
var kmlXml = new GGeoXml("https://autotravel.ru/kml.kml");
map.addOverlay(kmlXml); 

GEvent.addListener(map, "moveend", function() {
 kmlXml = new GGeoXml("https://autotravel.ru/kml.kml");
 map.addOverlay(kmlXml); 
});

</script>
